subject: Request: SSO assertions, SCIM delta and service-account audit for SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@starlighthealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@starlighthealth.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request: SSO assertions + SCIM deltas + service account inventory for SOC2

Hi Irene and Laura,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. We have a SOC 2 readiness window and our auditors asked for a short bundle of artifacts to validate provisioning, SSO/SAML and privileged identities. Can you provide the following by 12/10?

- A sample SAML assertion (redacted) that shows attributes your IdP sends to Redwood for an internal user (nameid, email, groups, session index).
- SCIM delta logs or a guidance file that explains how we can extract a delta for the last 30 days (ideally tsv/csv example).
- RBAC role snapshot showing active role definitions and which internal groups map to those roles.
- Service account inventory (service account id, owner, last-used timestamp, permissions).
- Confirmation that MFA is required for console / admin access, and where enforcement is logged.

If any of that needs a formal PO or DPA to share, let us know — otherwise please redact PII and provide sample files. If you have a short playbook we can point our auditors to (one pager + artifacts) that would be ideal.

Appreciate it — Alicia
Alicia Moreno
Security Manager, Starlight Health
alicia.moreno@starlighthealth.com

---

Attachment: request_outline.pdf (stub)
From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@starlighthealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO assertions + SCIM deltas + service account inventory for SOC2

Hi Alicia — thanks for the list and the timeline. We're happy to assemble a compact evidence package and a one-page playbook that maps each auditor ask to an artifact.

Quick clarifying items so we scope correctly:
- For the SAML assertion, do you want an assertion for an end-user (employee) only, or an example for a service account/automation principal as well? We can provide both (redacted).
- For SCIM, we can produce a delta export (CSV) and an explanatory README; the export will include user id, externalId, email, groups assigned, and timestamp. Are you okay with group IDs being redacted?
- For RBAC: we typically provide a role-definition CSV and a role-to-group mapping snapshot. Do you also need historical role-change logs or just the snapshot as of 2026-12-10?
- Service accounts: we can produce an inventory CSV and a short audit trail showing the last 90 days of token usage for those accounts (redacted).

If that's good, we'll start collecting artifacts and aim to deliver a zipped package and a short playbook by 12/13 to give you a cushion.

I'll coordinate with Jonas on the SCIM export and with Laura for RBAC & service-account proof.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

---

Attachment: redwood_saml_sample.xml (will attach in follow-up)
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Evidence request: SSO assertions + SCIM deltas + service account inventory for SOC2

Folks — forwarding Alicia's request. I'm going to take the RBAC and service-account inventory pieces.

Plan:
- I'll extract role definitions as-of 2026-12-10 into a CSV (columns: role_id, role_name, description, permissions_count, created_at) and a mapping (role_id -> group_id).
- I'll produce service_account_inventory_20261210.csv (service_account_id, owner, assigned_roles, last_token_use_iso, notes).
- For the audit/trail, we can produce a redacted token-use log showing service_account_id + last_used + region + action type (no payload). Should be fine for the auditors.

Jonas: can you queue a SCIM delta for the last 30 days from the provisioning service and drop it into the shared drive link (I'll create a folder and share)? If SCIM contains clear text emails we should redact the local-part per Alicia's request.

Irene: when you attach the SAML sample, make sure there is a short one-paragraph explanation of each attribute and which Redwood component consumes it.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

---

Attachment: (none yet)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SCIM delta and extraction notes

Laura / Irene,

SCIM delta export created and placed in the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcXyz-playbook-evidence (folder: scim_delta_20261110-20261210).

Notes included (scim_delta_readme.txt):
- Format: CSV with columns (timestamp_iso, operation, user_id, externalId, email_redacted, group_ids).
- Redaction: local-part masked (e.g., j*****@example.com) but domain preserved.
- Delta window: 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z -> 2026-12-10T23:59:59Z.
- How we generated it: provisioning-service API endpoint /scim/deltas with query params since and until; we used a service account with scim:read scope and rotated keys for extraction.
- Included a sample row and a small script (psuedo) showing the API call and curl example.

Attached a small role snapshot CSV (role_snapshot_20261210.csv) that maps role_id -> role_name -> group_id(s). This will help auditors understand the RBAC mapping.

I'll also export a brief service account usage trace (service_account_inventory_20261210.csv) but it's redacted for PII; the CSV includes last_token_use_iso and a boolean for whether the account has console access.

Let me know if you want me to extend the delta window.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Provisioning Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

---

Attachments: scim_delta_readme.txt, role_snapshot_20261210.csv, service_account_inventory_20261210.csv

Subject: Delivery: SAML sample, SCIM delta & service-account inventory for Starlight SOC2

Hi Alicia — attaching the evidence package we discussed and a one-page playbook that maps each auditor ask to the artifact delivered. Summary below; full files are in the shared drive link.

Summary of delivered artifacts (redacted where appropriate):
- redwood_saml_sample.xml: Example SAML assertion for an internal user (NameID masked). Doc includes attribute descriptions (email, groups, sessionIndex, authnContext).
- scim_delta_readme.txt + scim_delta_20261110-20261210.csv: Delta export with masking on local-part. Readme includes the API command we used and scope info.
- role_snapshot_20261210.csv: Current RBAC role definitions and role->group mappings.
- service_account_inventory_20261210.csv: Inventory of service accounts, owners, assigned roles, and last_token_use_iso.
- short_playbook.pdf (link in Drive): One-page mapping for auditors showing where each artifact answers the specific SOC2/SIG/CAIQ control.

MFA / enforcement note: MFA is enforced for console and admin actions. Enforcement events are logged to our central audit stream; we included a sample audit event (redacted) in the drive showing an admin console login that required MFA.

If the auditors want a signed statement about data redaction or a short DPA addendum before we hand over CSVs, we can do that — but we wanted to get these artifacts into your hands first.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcXyz-playbook-evidence
HubSpot case: HS-3421

If you want a short walkthrough call for the auditors, happy to join — suggest Wed 12/15 09:00-10:00 PT.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
